title: Pill, Drug and Medicine (1/2)
summaryZh: 老師從觀眾提問出發，解說藥丸、藥物與醫學這幾個字的用法差別。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Ask a Teacher

sentences.text: This week we answer a question from Zafir in Turkey.
sentences.zh: 本週我們要回答來自土耳其的 Zafir 提出的問題。

sentences.text: Would you please explain the difference between pill, drug, and medicine?
sentences.zh: 可以請你說明 pill、drug 和 medicine 之間的差別嗎？

sentences.text: Dear Zafir, thank you for writing to us.
sentences.zh: 親愛的 Zafir，謝謝你寫信給我們。

sentences.text: These three words are most often used when we talk about health.
sentences.zh: 這三個字最常用在談論健康的時候。

sentences.text: Let us begin with the word medicine.
sentences.zh: 我們先從 medicine 這個字開始。

sentences.text: One meaning is a substance or drug used to treat disease or pain.
sentences.zh: 它的一個意思是用來治療疾病或疼痛的物質或藥物。

sentences.text: But it is also a general term that describes the science or study of treating or curing disease.
sentences.zh: 但它也是個統稱，指的是研究如何治療或治癒疾病的科學或學問。

sentences.text: Here is an example of that use.
sentences.zh: 以下就是這個用法的例子。

sentences.text: Alex went to the university to study medicine.
Medication is another word you can use for medicine.
sentences.zh: Medication 是另一個可以用來表示 medicine 的字。

sentences.text: An antiviral drug is the only government-approved medication for COVID-19. Both words are countable and non-countable nouns.
sentences.zh: 抗病毒藥物是政府唯一核准用來治療 COVID-19 的藥。這兩個字既可以當可數名詞，也可以當不可數名詞。

sentences.text: A pill is a small rounded object that contains medicine.
sentences.zh: pill 是指含有藥物成分的小圓形顆粒。
